name: qa.iteration-pattern
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Generic QA specialist for the iteration_pattern template (and any future template that doesn't have its own specialist yet). Calls qa.core for basic checks + adds template-specific checks: (a) every deliverable slot in the manifest is filled, (b) every deliverable's min_bytes is met, (c) every file has a sensible extension. No vision-LLM calls -- this is the cheap, fast specialist for the universal template.

files.description: JSON object mapping deliverable slot keys to file paths.

template_path.description: Path to the Golden Path template (e.g. templates/iteration_pattern.json). If provided, the specialist uses its deliverables[] array to verify min_bytes and the slots are filled.
